# Effects

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/check-effect-budget.mjs from src/lib/effects/registry.js.
     Do not edit by hand: the registry is the source, and this file exists so
     the documentation cannot drift from what actually ships. -->

Every effect on the site declares what it is for, what it does at each of the
four graphics tiers, and what it costs. The sum is asserted in CI, which is
what stops the tenth effect from being the one nobody measured.

## Cost by tier

| Tier | Effects running | GPU / frame | Budget | CPU / frame | Budget |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 3 | 15 | 4.80 ms | 5 ms | 1.75 ms | 3 ms |
| 2 | 14 | 1.68 ms | 2 ms | 0.61 ms | 1.5 ms |
| 1 | 7 | 0.00 ms | 0 ms | 0.04 ms | 0.5 ms |
| 0 | 0 | 0.00 ms | 0 ms | 0.00 ms | 0 ms |

Tier 2 and below run reduced versions rather than the full effect, so their
cost is scaled by {"0":0,"1":0.1,"2":0.35,"3":1} — the same factors the tier
descriptions promise (half resolution, half frame rate).

## The register

### `background-field` · webgl

**Purpose.** Establishes that the page is a live rendering surface rather than a document, and carries the section-to-section character shift.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| eleven per-section motifs — fog, cells, dots, net, waves, topology, trunk, halo, globe, clouds, rings — crossfading on the damped section index, at up to 1.25 dpr, 30 fps | same shader at 0.5 dpr, 30 fps | the .hero-mesh CSS gradient — compositor only | a static gradient |

Cost at tier 3: **2.2 ms GPU**, **0.2 ms CPU**, 7.2 KB.
Requires: `webgl`.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `save-data`, `reduced-transparency`.
Group: `ambient`.

### `hero-gem` · webgl

**Purpose.** One object rendered in real time in the first viewport — the claim the whole site makes, stated once where it is cheapest to prove.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| thin-film iridescent metal on the shared environment, AgX-graded, pointer- and scroll-velocity-reactive | same material, reduced dpr | static poster image | none |

Cost at tier 3: **1.4 ms GPU**, **0.3 ms CPU**, 5.5 KB.
Requires: `webgl`.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `save-data`.
Group: `hero`.

### `fluid-canvas` · webgl

**Purpose.** Makes the hero respond to the pointer as a material rather than as a hover target.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 simulation passes (was 24 — T-058.2) | 4 passes at half resolution | off | off |

Cost at tier 3: **1.2 ms GPU**, **0.2 ms CPU**, 6.0 KB.
Requires: `webgl`, `hover`.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `save-data`.
Group: `hero`.

### `card-distortion` · webgl

**Purpose.** Communicates that a project card is a surface with depth, and rewards the hover that a recruiter is already making.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| displacement + RGB split, warmed on pointer intent | displacement only | CSS transform and colour change | static — a colour change on tap, no animation |

Cost at tier 3: **1.1 ms GPU**, **0.1 ms CPU**, 2.2 KB.
Requires: `webgl`, `hover`.
Respects: `reduced-motion`.
Group: `cards`.

### `custom-cursor` · dom

**Purpose.** Signals what each element does before it is clicked, through one shared pointer object rather than eight hover states.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| dot + velocity trail + magnetic pull | dot + trail | native cursor | native cursor |

Cost at tier 3: **0.1 ms GPU**, **0.2 ms CPU**, 1.9 KB.
Requires: `hover`, `fine-pointer`.
Respects: `reduced-motion`.
Group: `input`.

### `scroll-progress` · scroll-driven

**Purpose.** Tells the visitor how much of the page is left, which is the one thing a long single-page site otherwise hides.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| native scroll timeline on the compositor | native scroll timeline | native scroll timeline | static bar |

Cost at tier 3: **0.05 ms GPU**, **0 ms CPU**, 0.4 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`.
Group: `chrome`.

### `reveal` · scroll-driven

**Purpose.** Marks the boundary between one idea and the next as the visitor arrives at it.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| view() timeline, staggered by grid position | view() timeline, no stagger | fade only | no animation — content is present from the start |

Cost at tier 3: **0.1 ms GPU**, **0 ms CPU**, 0.7 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`.
Group: `entrance`.

### `parallax` · scroll-driven

|---|---|---|---|

Group: `hero`.

### `film-grain` · css

**Purpose.** Breaks up banding on the dark gradients — the single most common giveaway of an amateur dark theme.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| animated grain | static grain | static grain | off |

Cost at tier 3: **0.3 ms GPU**, **0 ms CPU**, 0.3 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `reduced-transparency`, `forced-colors`.
Group: `ambient`.

### `orrery` · css

**Purpose.** Fills the largest dead rectangle on the page with a Sun and eight planets that never stop turning — the "this is a live rendering surface" claim restated where a static gradient used to sit.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sun, eight planets, orbit rings, grid floor and ceiling, six star motes | Sun, eight planets, orbit rings, grid floor and ceiling, six star motes | Sun, eight planets, orbit rings and grid floor — motes and ceiling stand down | static, no animation, no promoted layers |

Cost at tier 3: **0.5 ms GPU**, **0 ms CPU**, 2.5 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `forced-colors`.
Group: `ambient`.

### `journey-rail` · scroll-driven

**Purpose.** Gives the one section that had no depth a track that recedes — each year arrives angled and set back, swings upright as it passes, and turns away behind you.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| cars swing on a view() timeline, year badges raised toward the camera, a light running the rail | same — it is one compositor transform per car and does not scale down usefully | same, and still free: the timeline is driven by the scroll, not by a frame loop | static — the plain upright list, which is also what any browser without view() timelines gets |

Cost at tier 3: **0.3 ms GPU**, **0 ms CPU**, 1.5 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `forced-colors`.
Group: `entrance`.

### `skill-reactor` · css

**Purpose.** Turns the skills illustration from a picture OF a 3-D stack into a 3-D object, and gives the section the one thing it was missing — something that moves before you touch it.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| two counter-turning rings, six billboarded panels, tethers, hub, gyros, motes; pointer tilts the gimbal | two counter-turning rings, six billboarded panels, tethers, hub, gyros, motes; pointer tilts the gimbal | rings, panels and tethers keep turning — corona, bloom and motes stand down | static — rings held a quarter turn apart, every panel facing the camera and at full opacity |

Cost at tier 3: **0.5 ms GPU**, **0.1 ms CPU**, 3.3 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `forced-colors`.
Group: `ambient`.

### `skill-card-holo` · css

**Purpose.** Makes the skill card read as a material rather than as a rectangle with a highlight: a hue-rotating diffraction grating composited color-dodge, a caustic tracking the pointer along the rim, and a second grid seventy pixels behind the plate so two depths parallax past each other.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| crossed gratings, caustic, far grid — all driven by the pointer angle and position | crossed gratings, caustic, far grid — all driven by the pointer angle and position | far grid only; the blended grating and the blurred caustic are the two most expensive layers here and stand down | static — grating and caustic removed entirely, far grid held at a fixed opacity with no pointer response |

Cost at tier 3: **0.35 ms GPU**, **0.05 ms CPU**, 2.1 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`, `forced-colors`.
Group: `ungrouped`.

### `theme-sweep` · waapi

**Purpose.** Makes a theme change legible as one deliberate event rather than a flicker.

| Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| View Transition with a clip-path reveal from the toggle | View Transition cross-fade | instant swap | instant swap |

Cost at tier 3: **0.6 ms GPU**, **0.2 ms CPU**, 0.9 KB.
Requires: nothing.
Respects: `reduced-motion`.
Group: `transition`.
